## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle *sūtra* on the five lay precepts and accompanying behavioural norms (*wēiyí*), translated by **Guṇavarman** ([求那跋摩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E6%91%A9)) at Jiànkāng in 431 CE.

**Abstract**

Companion text to [KR6k0065](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0065) (*Yōupósè wǔjièxiāng jīng*), this work supplies the practical-behavioural elaboration of the five lay precepts. Guṇavarman's full lay-precept apparatus comprises both the *wǔjièxiāng* (the doctrinal-categorical text) and the present *wēiyí* (the behavioural-procedural text), giving the early Chinese lay Buddhist communities the complete practical handbook for the *upāsaka pañca-śīla*.
